title: Bangladesh confirms Chinese J-10CE jet deal, citing Rafale kill in India-Pakistan clash

article.title: Bangladesh confirms Chinese J-10CE jet deal, citing Rafale kill in India-Pakistan clash
article.summary: Bangladesh has for the first time confirmed a long-expected deal to buy Chinese 4.5-generation J-10CE fighters, pointing to the jet’s combat performance against Rafale jets in last year’s India-Pakistan conflict. One military expert said it was a sign that the global perception of Chinese weapons was shifting and the market would gradually open.
